newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Sibneft 1996 pre-tax profit 1.1 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Sibneft 1996 pre-tax profit 1.1 trln rbls.

text.p: NOTES -- Full name is Sibirskaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya (Sibneft). Figures are calculated to Russian accounting standards. Comparative figures for 1995 are unavailable as Sibneft was founded in late 1995.
Sibneft is one of a dozen vertically integrated Russian oil groups created over the last few years. Its main operating unit is Noyabrskneftegaz.
A company official who declined to be named said Sibneft would not pay dividends on 1996 results, but would invest the money in its subsidiaries.
He said the company charter gave shareholders the right to dividends only after three years from the founding of the company. Shares have a 1.6 rouble face value.

Russian accounting standards differ significantly from those supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Russian companies can choose whether to show revenues and spending on a cash or accruals basis. Definitions of profit and assets differ from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
